samples.summary: Fix is incomplete: toggleList / indent / outdent also change block type but still never fire the cursor-move callbacks
samples.evidence: `toggleList` (editor.ts:2871-2885) calls `doc.setBlockType(block.id, 'paragraph' | 'list-item', …)` and ends with `invalidateLayout(); render();` — no `notifyStyleApplied()`. Same for `indent()` (ends `render();` at 2904) and `outdent()` (ends `render();` at 2925), both of which call `doc.setBlockType` for list levels. These are exactly the mutation the diff describes as stale-making: converting a Heading 2 to a list item changes `getBlockType()` (label 'Heading 2' → 'Normal text' via getBlockLabel, text-style-options.ts:106-114) while the toolbar's only refresh trigger (docs-formatting-toolbar.tsx:317-323 `editor.onCursorMove(refresh)`) never fires. So the exact staleness class the PR fixes for `setBlockType` remains reachable through the bullet/indent buttons.
searchedFor: Grep 'notifyStyleApplied' in packages/docs/src (all call sites listed)
Grep 'onCursorMove' in packages/frontend/src (only docs-view.tsx:394 and docs-formatting-toolbar.tsx:323 subscribe)
Read text-style-group.tsx (reads getBlockType at render time, no own subscription)

samples.summary: New comment's claim that "every sibling mutation below notifies" is false
samples.evidence: The added comment says "Same reason every sibling mutation below notifies." The immediately following siblings `toggleList` (2871), `indent` (2886) and `outdent` (2906) do NOT call `notifyStyleApplied()`. The comment will mislead the next reader into assuming coverage the code does not have.
